annotations.title: Bank commercial real estate loan credit by quarter

description: Quarterly credit quality of U.S. bank commercial real estate loans: the Federal Reserve's seasonally adjusted delinquency and net charge-off rates (all commercial banks, CRE excluding farmland, up to 12 quarters) and FDIC call-report noncurrent rates split into nonresidential, multifamily and construction and land loans (up to 5 quarters), with quarter-over-quarter changes and the dollar size of the book.

quarters.description: How many recent quarters of Fed data to return (1 to 12, default 8). FDIC data covers the latest 5 at most.
